vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: kg-note-method-obsidian
Version: 2.30.0

The skill bundle implements a complex Knowledge Graph management system for Obsidian notes, utilizing high-risk capabilities such as automated network searches for content/images, file system modifications (read/write/delete), and shell command execution (specifically `curl -I` in SKILL.md to validate image URLs). While these actions are functionally aligned with the stated purpose of note organization and enrichment, the extensive use of network/shell access and the management of task states via a local directory (D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost\_working\) represent a significant attack surface. Per the provided criteria, these risky but plausibly needed capabilities are classified as suspicious in the absence of clear malicious intent.

llm.summary: This is a coherent Obsidian note-organizing skill, but it asks the agent to make broad note changes and mandatory web/image requests based on local note content.

dimensions.detail: The requested capabilities align with KG-style Obsidian organization, but they include creating relationship notes, patching frontmatter, removing links/content, deduplicating, and enriching notes from the web.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Several workflows are mandatory and expansive, such as associating every valid searched note and using checklists for 5+ file operations; explicit user approval is clearly described for the special check workflow, but not for all bulk-edit workflows.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present, and the static scan reported no suspicious patterns.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill targets a local Obsidian vault and requires external web/image lookups during note processing, which can expose note topics and add remote resources to local notes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The _working checklist mechanism intentionally persists task state across interrupted sessions and can influence later operations; this is disclosed but should be reviewed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Use this only if you want an agent to actively reorganize your Obsidian vault. Back up the vault first, review generated checklists before execution, and disable or approve web/image enrichment explicitly if your notes contain private topics.

evidence.explanation: The skill directs bulk create/modify/delete-style file operations and requires relationship creation for every found association, which can expand a single note task into many vault changes.
evidence.snippet: 任务预期产生 ≥5 个文件操作（新建/修改/删除）时，必须先建清单再动手；搜到即关联 — 在主体笔记和每一个搜到的关联笔记之间，新建关系笔记；已有更完整→删

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Run it on a backed-up vault, require a dry-run or explicit confirmation before bulk edits/deletions, and restrict operations to the intended folder.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A mistaken search result, classification, or inferred relationship could cause many Obsidian notes to be created or changed before the user notices.

evidence.explanation: The workflow mandates external searches and remote image checks based on local note content, and embeds remote URLs into notes without a clear privacy boundary or approval step.
evidence.snippet: 同步图片嵌入（主动，不可跳过）：读内容时判断是否需配说明性图片... 主动搜索网络嵌入... 百度图片 / Google Images / Wikipedia... 格式：`![描述](url)`；疑似失效的网络图片 → `curl -I` 检查状态码

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Make web/image enrichment opt-in, show search terms before sending them, prefer local images, and document which external providers may receive data.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private note topics or interests may be sent to search/image providers, and opening notes later may load resources from external hosts.

evidence.explanation: The skill stores persistent task state in checklist files and later reads those files to decide where to resume work.
evidence.snippet: 中途中止 → 清单文件保留，下次会话恢复；有同名任务的清单 → read_file 完成检查清单 → 从未完成步开始续接

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review any _working checklist before resuming, remove stale task files, and treat checklist contents as untrusted until revalidated.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Stale or manually edited checklist files could influence later note operations, although the skill also says to re-run validation before acting.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill can cascade one note task into many local note creations, modifications, and removals.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account privileges, or delegated account access are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: Local note content can drive mandatory external web/image requests, and persistent checklist files can shape future operations.
